title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Adjudicating Cases Involving Disputes Relating to the Conversion of Central-Level Fiscal Funds into State Capital of Certain Central Enterprises
keywords_en: application for retrial; limitation of action; disputes concerning state capital funds of central enterprises
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Adjudicating Cases Concerning Disputes Related to Conversion of Central-level Fiscal Funds into State Capital of Certain Central Enterprises

Fa [2012] No. 295

To: High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region

On July 18, 2012, the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of the State Council, the National Development and Reform Commission, and the Ministry of Finance jointly issued the Notice on Further Improving the Work Concerning Conversion of Central-level Fiscal Funds into State Capital of Certain Central Enterprises (Guo Zi Fa Fa Gui [2012] No. 103, hereinafter referred to as the "Notice"). In order to properly adjudicate cases involving disputes related to the conversion of central-level fiscal funds into state capital of certain central enterprises, we hereby forward the Notice to you. In addition, after consulting with the relevant ministries and commissions of the State Council, we hereby notify you of the following issues:

1. Where a relevant central enterprise initiates civil litigation concerning the confirmation of rights as a contributor of a company or enterprise, the return of funds, or other matters arising from the conversion of the central-level fiscal funds covered by the Notice into state capital, the people's court shall accept the case. Related cases already accepted by the people's court before the issuance of the Notice may continue to be adjudicated by the people's court.

The cause of action for a case in which a relevant central enterprise requests the return of funds shall be a dispute over the return of funds.

2. Where, before the issuance of the Notice, the parties reached an agreement concerning the confirmation of rights as a contributor of a company or enterprise, the return of funds, or other matters, the validity of such agreement shall be recognized if it does not violate the relevant national policies.

3. Except for cases already accepted by the people's court, the statute of limitations for a relevant central enterprise's claim for the return of funds shall commence from the date on which the period specified in Article 5 of the Notice expires.

The claim of a party for confirmation of its rights as a contributor of a company or enterprise shall not be subject to the statute of limitations.

4. Where a relevant central enterprise requests the fund-using enterprise to return the funds and to pay interest calculated from the date on which the period specified in Article 5 of the Notice expires based on the benchmark loan interest rate of the bank for the same period and same grade, the people's court shall support such a request.

5. This Notice shall apply to cases of first instance and second instance that have not yet been concluded before the issuance of this Notice; it shall not apply to cases that have been concluded before the issuance of this Notice, where the parties apply for retrial or where a retrial is initiated under the trial supervision procedure. However, cases in which a ruling was made not to accept the case or to dismiss the lawsuit on the basis of Article 4 of the Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Issue of Whether to Accept Disputes Arising from the Adjustment and Transfer of State-owned Assets of Enterprises by the Government (Fa Fu [1996] No. 4) or on the ground that the relevant policy was unclear are excepted.

If any problems are encountered by people's courts at all levels in the course of adjudicating cases involving disputes related to the conversion of central-level fiscal funds into state capital of certain central enterprises, they may report them level by level to the Supreme People's Court.

December 11, 2012
